description: Machine-readable capability evidence register (connector #209). A provider's verified list names the PeopleCapability values that have deployment evidence per docs/providers/<provider>-capability-evidence.md. connector:health:check reports any capability an adapter declares that is not verified here, and any verified capability the adapter no longer declares. An entry is a bare name or {capability, evidence, verified_at, verified_by} as appended by connector:capability:verify (#231); entries are appended, never rewritten.

blb-people.notes: Positions have no PeopleCapability case; People's ReadsWorkforcePositions travels under organization_directory on the bootstrap page (connector #299).
